reader.requirement: Every level-01 record under one FD (any organization), SD or CD shares one storage area (an implicit redefinition); records under an RD are excluded.
reader.edition-search: grep of FileControlBinder.FileSection.cs, CommunicationSectionBinder.cs, DataItem.cs, ClassifyRedefinesClassesPass.cs and SequentialIoEmitter.cs for CobolVersion, Edition.Is/Version, DialectBehavior, ConstructRegistry, DialectLevel: the only hits are RECORD CONTAINS (FileSection.cs line 406) and SELECT WHEN (SequentialIoEmitter.cs line 593), neither on the record-area link. IsOutOfLineRecord excludes only dynamic-length, dynamic-capacity and pointer records, none of which exist at 1985, so every 1985 record is linked.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers an SD only; an FD of each organization, an OCCURS DEPENDING record and CD records are not exercised by it

reader.notes: LinkImplicitRecordArea makes every non-anchor FD and SD record an ImplicitFileRecord redefinition of the anchor, and CommunicationSectionBinder.BindEntry does the same for CD records; no edition arm. The RD exclusion is not observable through a data reference (report groups are not MOVE targets) and was not probed.

refuter.evidence: l1.cob at --std 85 (run refute-1985-106/l1-001): FD with 01 records of 3, 10 and 4 chars (shorter anchor first): MOVE to R2 seen through R1 and R3A/R3B, MOVE to R1 changes only R2's first 3 chars (R2=XYZDEFGHIJ), a second FD's record untouched (Q1=QQQQQQQQQQ); FD EXTERNAL with RECORD IS VARYING ... DEPENDING ON (1985 forms) shares the area among its own 01s (V2=12, V1=ZZ345678) and with another program's differently described 01s of the same external file (SUB W1=ZZ3, V1C=kkk45678); SD with 01s of 2 and 6 chars (SR1=MN, SR2=abOPQR).
